designDirection: Modern, smooth, premium wayfarer-style AI/AR smart glasses family (SDF-sculpted). Component catalog kept identical to v4.

Left Polished Acetate Lens Rim.description: High-gloss molded full-rim front eyewear frame. The rounded rectangular lens opening is sized for prescription-style lenses; final ophthalmic fit remains a design-stage item.
